description: This file defines the SenderActivity class, which is an Android Activity responsible for sending user input messages to another activity (ReceiverActivity). It sets up a button and text input, and on button click, it creates an intent to start ReceiverActivity with the message.

classes.name: SenderActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that sends a message to ReceiverActivity when a button is clicked.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and establishes a click listener for the send message button.
